title: Distillation and Faithfulness: Does Distilled R1 Inherit the Teacher's Unfaithfulness?

original_idea.body: Run faithfulness battery across R1-Distill size ladder; map faithfulness scaling.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: maps faithfulness scaling within a distilled family deployers actually use.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: same battery across a public size ladder; clear methodology.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: faithfulness battery across 4 checkpoint sizes.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly, public checkpoints, weak lab incentive.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference across 1.5B-32B; 32B needs a capable single GPU or quantization.

novelty.reasoning: Distillation-vs-faithfulness scaling at student scale plausibly open.
